cat > /home/wlia0047/ar57/wenyu/GeneRec/results/research/issue121/rounds/round_20261025_173300_854/agents/rebuttal_transition-anchored-hyperbolic-codebook_r0/rebuttal.txt <<'EOF'
CHANGE: Revise the evaluation specification to require, alongside both-on and the existing geometry-off and behavior-off runs, a matched train-profile-shuffle control: permute complete nonzero directed profiles across item IDs before training, retaining their values, model, initialization, seeds, and budget. Report the actual transition counts/profile coverage and learned displacement norms, and compare SID changes and the existing Stage3 test_R@10 across both-on, shuffled-profile, and zero-profile runs; treat improvement over both controls plus profile-dependent SID changes as the evidence criterion. The zero-profile (or zero-warp) limit alone is explicitly not evidence for either contribution; the nonzero matched comparisons measure whether item-to-profile alignment contributes beyond generic warp capacity, and the geometry-off comparison tests the curved composition. This directly tests the hypothesized coupling without changing its mechanism or adding scores.
UNCHANGED: Training-only adjacent directed transition profiles, the learned bounded tangent displacement, Poincare exp-map/Mobius-add/log-map composition before the unchanged Euclidean RQ quantizer, ordinary reconstruction/VQ training, leakage boundary, and existing Stage3 Recall@10 outcome.
REMAINING: A positive controlled result would support this mechanism only on the specified dataset and evaluation; it cannot rule out all popularity or sparse-noise explanations, nor guarantee transfer to other settings.
EOF
